questionText:

Statement I: Reporters work primarily in the field gathering facts, conducting interviews, and filing raw news copy from assigned beats.
Statement II: Sub-editors (copy editors) work inside the newsroom at the desk, processing, polishing, fact-checking, and headlining the filed copy.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

Both statements are true. Reporting (field) and sub-editing (desk) represent the two complementary pillars of print journalism.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
